description: NaLi₅Mn₂P₂(CO₇)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.84 Å. There are five inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.42 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.37 Å. In the third Li site, Li is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.61 Å. In the fourth Li site, Li is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.59 Å. In the fifth Li site, Li is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.53 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.53 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.52 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.31 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (1.55 Å) and three longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Li and one C atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OLi₃C tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Li, and one C atom to form distorted ONaLi₂C tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one OLi₂MnP trigonal pyramid and  an edgeedge with one ONaLiMnP tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Li, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Li, one Mn, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one C atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing OLi₂MnP trigonal pyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form OLi₂MnP tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent OLi₂MnP trigonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one OLi₃C tetrahedra. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiMnP tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one OLi₂MnP trigonal pyramid and  an edgeedge with one ONaLi₂C tetrahedra. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom.
